title: Administrative Assistant
description:
Administrative Assistant

12 month contract

Based in Portsmouth

Offering 20ph Inside IR35

Do you have experience as an Administrative assistant, Secretary, or similar within a large corporate/defence industry setting?

Are you proficient in Microsoft Office Suite?

Do you want to work with an industry-leading company?

If your answer to these is yes, then this could be the role for you!

As the Administrative Assistant, you will be working alongside a market-leading Defence and Aerospace company who are constantly growing and developing. They are always looking to bring on new talents such as yourself and further develop your skills to enable you to grow within the company and industry.

You will be involved in:
- Act as the central point, supporting all functions (Engineering, PM, PMO, Quality, Finance etc.) within the Connected Intelligence business at Portsmouth.
- Provide support to the Functions in preparing all logistics and correspondence for internal and external visitors to site
- Support the Site Director in preparing for any high-profile visits
- Manage complex calendars, schedule cross-functional meetings, and book local and international travel for department heads and teams
- Support the Functional heads in managing and maintaining complex calendars, scheduling meetings, appointments, and travel arrangements for assigned personnel
- As required by functional heads, prepare and edit correspondence, reports, presentations, and other documents, and track action items from high-level divisional meetings
- Gather performance metrics from various teams to compile weekly or monthly business unit reports
- Process expense reports, purchase orders, and other financial documentation in accordance with company policies
- Support office management tasks such as ordering supplies, managing facilities requests, and liaising with external vendors

Your skillset & experience:
- Experience as a Secretary, Administrative Assistant, or in a similar support role, preferably within a large corporate or defence industry setting
- Organisational and time management skills with the ability to prioritise effectively and manage multiple tasks simultaneously
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a keen eye for detail and accuracy
- Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build rapport with diverse stakeholders
- Discretion and ability to handle confidential information with integrity
- Proactive attitude with a strong sense of initiative and problem-solving abilities
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment

If this all sounds like something you will be interested in then simply apply and we can discuss the opportunity further!

title: Reception Administrator

description: We are looking for a friendly, professional, and highly organised Reception Administrator to join our busy reception team. This role involves working 15 hrs per week on a shift pattern, so flexibility is essential. This fast-paced position is ideal for someone who enjoys working with people and delivering outstanding customer service. As the first point of contact for patients, visitors, and staff, you will provide a welcoming, efficient, and professional reception service. You will play a key role in creating a positive experience for everyone who visits our service, while supporting the smooth day-to-day running of the reception area. If you are passionate about providing excellent customer service and enjoy being part of a supportive team, we would love to hear from you. Key responsibilities include answering and managing a high-volume switchboard, directing calls to the appropriate departments, providing information and guidance to patients and visitors, and signposting staff and members of the public to the correct areas across the site. You will also support the smooth day-to-day operation of the reception area by maintaining accurate records, handling enquiries efficiently, and working closely with colleagues across multiple departments. The successful candidate will have excellent communication and interpersonal skills, the ability to remain calm under pressure, and a commitment to delivering a high standard of service in a busy healthcare environment. Teamwork, professionalism, and a positive attitude are essential for this role.
